notes.title: New video about Dissection Simulator: Frog Edition from Fynnpire
notes.content:
Youtuber Fynnpire has recently played our experience in this very funny and entertaining video.  Give it a watch:
https://youtu.be/gKjGWgW10Fw

notes.title: Version 1.1 Released
notes.content: [i]Dissection Simulator: Frog Edition[/i] has been updated in Version 1.1.  This fixes bugs related to calibration of the controllers as well as a bug where organs would remain highlighted after removing them from the forceps.
